# Character enrichment sources

These optional, unreviewed annotations were supplied in the character-enrichment
handoff. The original canonical catalogue remains separate and unchanged.

- Make Me a Hanzi dictionary, commit bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92:
  LGPL-3.0-or-later. Corresponding dictionary source and licence notices are in
  `notices/`. Source: https://github.com/skishore/makemeahanzi/tree/bddc96d41bef78427ed0e034e9f7e31d71fd1b92
- Hanzi Writer Data 2.0.1: Arphic Public License. Geometry is fetched on demand
  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their
  regional qualifiers. The supplied manifest records permission evidence, not
  an independently established licence for all underlying characters. No full
  BabelStone snapshot is redistributed here. Source: https://www.babelstone.co.uk/CJK/IDS.TXT
- GF 0014-2009: eight bounded textual rule-example annotations only. No PDF,
  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

`manifest.json` retains the supplied source versions, hashes, consumer policy,
licence-notice references and coverage. Original generator/audit utilities and
all their inputs were not provided; the local split adapter is not a substitute
for rerunning that upstream audit. Exact source agreement and complete stroke
coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 䜌# is 絲 thread(s) + 言 (make verbal distinctions → distinct) → make tangled threads distinct by stretching and untangling them. 戀 adds 心 heart/emotions → attempt to untangle confused feelings (of longing, anxiety, or love) by figuratively stretching them straight (compare 攣 and 亂) → *long for*; *be anxious for*; *love*. The top element of the present form of the character represents a tremendous simplification.
敬也。从心難聲。
As per 矍# (enclose in the hands) + 心 heart/emotions → *fear* (← fear experienced by captive game) → *be in awe*.
愚也。从心𥫔聲。
A depiction of a long *halberd* with a curved handle and sharp blade → *spear*; *lance*. Also, *battle*.
平頭𢧢也。从弋，一橫之。象形。凡戈之屬皆从戈。
The relevant seal inscription form is a variant of 戈 spear/halberd, being a *battle-ax* with a rounded handle → *halberd*. The shape of the weapon also permitted it to scoop objects up/out.
斧也。从戈𠄌聲。《司馬法》曰：“夏執玄戉，殷執白戚，周左杖黃戉，右秉白髦。”凡戉之屬皆从戉。”
A depiction of a *battle-ax* with a curved handle in which the base of the blade is covered and concealed (compare 矛). *Fifth in a series* and *fifth calendar sign* are borrowed meanings.
中宮也。象六甲五龍相拘絞也。戊承丁，象人脅。凡戊之屬皆从戊。

A depiction of a slender-handled ancient weapon (compare 戊 and the phonetically similar 戉, both indicating battle axes) used to exterminate enemies. *Dog* (as the *eleventh sign of the Chinese zodiac*) and *7-9 P.M.* are borrowed meanings.
滅也。九月，陽气微，萬物畢成，陽下入地也。五行，土生於戊，盛於戌。从戊含一。凡戌之屬皆从戌。
Originally an abbreviated form# of 戚 battle-ax + 人 person → garrison → *protect*; *defend*; *guard*; *a guard*. In the present form, 人 is replaced by a diagonal mark.
守邊也。从人持戈。
Originally 矛# pike/halberd + 甲 armor/helmet → seize (soft luxury) goods by use of arms → *weapon*; *armed*; *battle*; *war*; *barbarian*.

Originally, 丁# (nail) + a pounding tool → pound nails (straight) into an object → *make* (← object/structure containing nails); *do* (← pound nails as one form of doing work) → *become*; *complete*; *achieve*; *established*; *existing*. In the present form, the pounding tool resembles 戊 battle-ax.
就也。从戊丁聲。
The relevant oracle bone form of this character is a variant of 戈 spear/halberd, indicating a weapon/knife with a serrated blade (i.e., a blade the teeth of which are in alignment).
施身自謂也。或說我，頃頓也。从戈从𠄒。𠄒，或說古垂字。一曰古殺字。凡我之屬皆从我。
廾# pair of hands + 戈 spear/halberd → *admonish* or *prohibit* by the threat of force → *warn*; *instruct*.
警也。从廾持戈，以戒不虞。
戈 spear/halberd (doubled), a variant form of the element minus 韭 described in 韱 (the tip of a long, slender weapon) → fine/*slight* (← fine/slight tip).
賊也。从二戈。《周書》曰：“戔戔巧言。”
As per 爿# (long and slender) + 戈 spear/halberd → long, slender weapon such as a pole or spear, used to *wound*, *maim* or *kill*.
搶也。他國臣來弑君曰戕。从戈爿聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines 戈 spear/halberd + 囗# circular enclosure (here suggesting an enclosed parcel of land) → defend enclosed land/an enclosure. *A certain*, *a*, *some*, *or*, and *possibly* are all borrowed meanings (compare 有).
邦也。从囗从戈，以守一。一，地也。
As per 尗# as described in 叔 (slender and pendent) + 戉 (battle-ax) → *battle-ax* with a slender, elliptical haft → *hatchet*. (Familial) *relative*, *grieve* and *sad* are borrowed meanings.
戉也。从戉尗聲。
An abbreviated form# of 頁 head + 戈 spear/halberd → *strike* an opponent's head with a bladed weapon → *piece of metal/stone* (produced by striking).
𢧢也。从戈从𦣻。讀若棘。
闕。从戈从音。
甚# extreme + 戈 spear/halberd → *cut deeply and kill*.
刺也。从戈甚聲。
As per 咠# as described in 葺 (press) + 戈 spear/halberd → *collect* and *put/store away* weapons → *cease* (← finish the process of putting/storing away).
藏兵也。从戈咠聲。《詩》曰：“載戢干戈。”
《周禮》：侍臣執戣，立于東垂。兵也。从戈癸聲。
As per 晉# (variant form of 晋 insert) + 戈 spear/halberd → insert a bladed weapon into an enemy → *destroy*; (cause to) *disappear*.
滅也。从戈晉聲。《詩》曰：“實始戩商。”
As per 𢦏# as described in 栽 (cut; sever) + 隹 short, squat bird → *cut off* a piece of poultry → *cut*; *sever*; *leave off*; *stop*.
長搶也。从戈寅聲。《春秋傳》有擣戭。
As per 翏# (separate from a main unit) + 戈 spear/halberd → execute a person, separating him from the group to which he belongs (compare 僇) → *kill*.
殺也。从戈翏聲。
As per 單# (weapon) + 戈 spear/halberd → use various weapons to beat enemies into submission or to death → *fight*; *war*.
鬬也。从戈單聲。

An abbreviated form# of 虛 (sunken) + an element combining 豆 (food stand, here a shape indicator) and 戈 spear/halberd (the combination indicating a particular type of bladed weapon) → sink a spear in a hole in the ground as a trap for game → *sport with* (← hunt for sport ← hunt). *Laugh uproariously*, *frolic*, *joke*, *play*, *tease* and *flirt* are by figurative association with "sport with" → *theater*; *drama*; *show*.
三軍之偏也。一曰兵也。从戈䖒聲。
As per 翟# (rise high) + 戈 spear/halberd → raise a bladed weapon and *stab*, *thrust* or *poke*. Also, *stamp* and *seal*.

As per 異# (raise) + an abbreviated form of 載 place atop → *be crowned* → *receive*. Extended meanings include *be revered/respected* and *be looked up to*, along with humble forms of verbs such as *eat*, *drink*, *take* and *accept* (← receive humbly).
分物得增益曰戴。从異𢦔聲。
護也。半門曰戶。象形。凡戶之屬皆从戶。
Originally the left half of 門 gate, representing a rectangular *door* → *household*; *counter for houses*.
隘也。从戶乙聲。

Originally, 犬 dog/beast + not 戸 but rather 立# (exert continuous downward pressure) → fend off repeated, frenetic attacks from a dog or beast → *go/come back*; *return*. Associated meanings include *be contrary*, (barely) *reach* and *restore*. Also, *violate* and *vomit* (← contrary), as well as *be settled*. As with 器, 犬 is now replaced by 大.
輜車㫄推戶也。从戶大聲。讀與釱同。
曲也。从犬出戶下。戾者，身曲戾也。

As per 方# (spread right and left, or in all directions) + 戸 door (→ room) → the rooms of a spreading (= expansive) residence → *room*; *house*. *Tassel*, *tuft*, *cluster*, *bunch* and *section/segment* (of fruit) are borrowed meanings.
室在㫄也。从戶方聲。
戸# door + 斤 ax → use a bladed implement to shave wood into the shape of a door. *Place* is a borrowed meaning → *partition*; *about*; *in case*; *local*; *counter for places*.
伐木聲也。从斤戶聲。《詩》曰：“伐木所所。”

Originally 反# (thin sheet of wood) + 冊 (bamboo slats) → thin, flat *nameplate* (compare 榜) spread upon a gate → (votive) *tablet*; *flat*; *thin* → *left-hand element of a Han/Chinese character* (← element by which a character may be identified ← nameplate).
署也。从戶、冊。戶冊者，署門戶之文也。
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 戸 door → *bolt/bar* fixed in place to *lock a door*.
冋# as described in 冂 (border) + 戸 door → door serving as a border between a residence and the outside world. Eventually the term came to refer to a *bolt/bar* used to lock a door (compare 閂).
外閉之關也。从戶冋聲。
戶牖之閒謂之扆。从戶衣聲。
戸 here an abbreviated form# of 扁 (spread, but remain in contact) + 羽 feather/wing → folding *fan*, the slats of which spread but remain in contact when the fan is in use .
扉也。从戶，从翄聲。
As per 邑 (kneel and spread arms in obeisance) + 戸# door → retinue of prostrate subjects attending by a door → *obey*; *follow*.
夏后同姓所封，戰於甘者。在鄠，有扈谷、甘亭。从邑戶聲。
As per 非# (spread in alignment to right and left) + 戸 door → doors swinging open in alignment → *door* → *title page* (of a book).
戶扇也。从戶非聲。

A depiction of a *hand* showing the five fingers in a curved, gripping position. Extended meanings include *arm*; *paw*; *foreleg*; *a handle*; *helper*; *a means*; *technique*; (in board games) *a move*; *a type*; *a direction*; and *handwriting*.
拳也。象形。凡手之屬皆从手。
A depiction of rocks piled to cut off/dam a river → *stop/cut off* → *a little*; *for the first time*. *Genius* and *ability* are borrowed meanings, as is (number of) *years old*.
艸木之初也。从丨上貫一，將生枝葉。一，地也。凡才之屬皆从才。

纔.explanation: 纔 is a differentiated traditional form for the adverb meaning just/only/recently; 才 meaning talent or ability remains 才.
纔.example: 天才 → 天才; 刚才 → 剛纔 (differentiated spelling)
纔.usageCaveat: Traditional practice can also use 才 in adverbial contexts.
纔.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: As per 乚# a variant form of 乙 (rise and hit a blocking element) + 手 hand/action indicator → *pull* up (and through) → *prick/stab*.
《易》筮，再扐而後卦。从手力聲。
Variant form of 撲: *strike*/*pound*.
As per 丁# (strike a nail) + 手 hand/action indicator → *hit/strike*.
擊也。从手丁聲。
As per 乃# (soft and clingy) + 手 hand/action indicator → toss an object softly → *throw*.
因也。从手乃聲。

As per 乇# as described in 宅 (raise an object held in the palm ) + 手 hand/action indicator → hold/raise in the palm → support → *rely on* . *Place upon* and *entrust/charge with* are borrowed meanings.
疾擊也。从手勺聲。
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 手 hand/action indicator → *run a pole through an object*, raise it, then *carry on the shoulders*.
橫關對舉也。从手工聲。
指麾也。从手亏聲。
As per 干# (press against in defense) + 手 hand/action indicator → *use a shield in protection*; *fight/ward off*; *pin/render immobile*. Also, *resist* and *restrain*.
忮也。从手干聲。
从上挹也。从手卂聲。讀若莘。
As per 叉# (stab at) + 手 hand/action indicator → *stab*; *fishing spear*. In Japan, the character has also been borrowed to mean *by the way* or *well*.

口 here an abbreviated form# of 叩 (prostrate) + 手 hand/action indicator → *beat* into a prostrate position → *knock* → *pull/drag* (down). Also, *discount* (← beat/knock down a price). *Button*, *clasp* and *hook* are via reinterpretation of the constituent elements of this character (as hand + a button or other fastener) .
牽馬也。从手口聲。
動也。从手兀聲。
刄/刃 blade + 手 hand. 扨 is a effectively a variant form of 扠 *by the way*; *well*.
As per 丑# (curve/bend) + 手 hand/action indicator → curve/bend/*twist the hand in seizing* → *pull/draw tight*. Compare 搦.
As per 分# (split) + 手 hand/action indicator → dress up in *disguise*; *dress up* (as) (← divide one's habitual and temporary identities).
握也。从手分聲。讀若粉。
As per 及# (press on) + 手 hand/action indicator → exert pressure in taking objects in hand → *collect*; *handle*; *dispose*; *treat*; *deal with*.
收也。从手及聲。
刮也。从手介聲。
As per 夫# (stretch out/over) + 手 hand/action indicator → stretch/hold out the arms to *support* oneself or another person → *help*.
左也。从手夫聲。
比# compare + 手 hand/action indicator → *critique*; *criticize* (← critique/criticize by comparing).
側擊也。从手氏聲。

Originally a variant form of 抑 (push/press down upon another in forcing him to kneel) with the specific sense of gripping tightly in exerting pressure → *choke*; *compress*; *tighten*. *Yoke* is a borrowed meaning via 軛. For the idea of choking, compare 嗌.

The relevant seal inscription form is an abbreviated form# of 丞 (raise/rise) + 手 hand/action indicator → *receive*/*succeed to* (= be raised to) a high(er) post/rank etc. → *accept*; *hear*; *listen to* (← receive word of).
奉也。受也。从手从卪从𠬞。
As per 支# (skillfully manipulate) + 手 hand/action indicator → *technique* involving skillful manipulation → *skill* → *accomplishment*.
巧也。从手支聲。
卞# restless/unsettled + 手 hand/action indicator → *clap* (← restless motion) → *applaud*; *clap a hand on*.
As per 少# (small/slight) + 手 hand/action indicator → create shavings or other small portions of a large object → *excerpt*; *extract* (← portions of a whole).
折也。从手月聲。
As per 夬# (scoop out) + 手 hand/action indicator → *scoop/gouge/hollow out*; *bore*. Also, *archery glove* (compare 玦).
挑也。从手夬聲。
As per 巴# (spread) + 手 hand → spread the hands and *take/grasp* an object (compare 捕).
握也。从手巴聲。
深擊也。从手冘聲。讀若告言不正曰抌。
上舉也。从手升聲。《易》曰：“抍馬，壯，吉。”
有所失也。《春秋傳》曰：“抎子，辱矣。”从手云聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is 手 hand/action indicator + an element# that is 印 (press down upon a person in forcing him/her to kneel) written in reverse → push/press down upon another in forcing him to kneel → *exert pressure*; *restrain*; *hold down*; *control* → *suppress*; *repress*. The present form uses 卬.
As per 予# (stretch) + 手 hand/action indicator → stretch. *State* and *express* are borrowed meanings, via 序.
挹也。从手予聲。
As per 爪# (pick/pluck) + 手 hand/action indicator → *pick* → *pinch*. Also, *scratch*, an atavistic meaning derived from 爪.
As per 不# (bulge) + 手 hand/action indicator → scoop up a bulging portion → *scoop up in the hands*; *to scoop*; *one scoopful*.
As per 殳# (throw) + 手 hand/action indicator → *throw*; *fling*; *cast* → (cause to) *stay* (← throw and cause to stick in place) → *sell at a loss* (← practically throw away).
擿也。从手从殳。
斗# ladle + 手 hand/action indicator → *shake off/out* excess food or liquid in ladling → *shake*; *tremble*.
As per 亢# (stretch) + 手 hand/action indicator → stretch the arms straight out in resistance or opposition → *resist*; *oppose* → *rival*; *compete*.
扞也。从手亢聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows a tree cut in two + 斤 ax → chop/cut lumber → *break*; *snap*; *interrupt*; *die*; *lose* → *bend*; *fold*. Also, *turn* and *suitable time/moment* (← reach a turning point ← interrupt) → *opportunity*. Other extended meanings include *yield to* (← bend in defeat ← bend), *judge* and *decide on* (← decisive decision ← decisive cut; compare 判, 斷, 裁 and 決), *at the time of* (← time ← suitable time), and *folded object* or *small wooden box* (← end or point created by a fold ← fold).

摺.explanation: 摺 is used for folding/pleating in some traditional writing; 折 meaning break, discount, etc., remains 折.
摺.example: 折叠 → 摺疊 (regional usage); 折断 → 折斷
摺.usageCaveat: Traditional usage varies regionally; 折疊 is also seen.
摺.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: The right-hand element# combines a variant form of 尤 (contracted hand) + 力 power/energy → contract the hand about an object preliminary to hurling it. 抛 adds 手 hand/action indicator → *throw/hurl* → *throw away*; *discard*.
棄也。从手从尤从力，或从手𠠵聲。案：《左氏傳》通用摽。《詩》：“摽有梅。”摽，落也。義亦同。
開也。从手只聲。讀若抵掌之抵。
撣也。从手平聲。
捫持也。从手布聲。
As per 皮# (open up) + 手 hand/action indicator → *open up*. 披 was devised to replace 皮.
从㫄持曰披。从手皮聲。
挹也。从手且聲。讀若樝棃之樝。
以車鞅擊也。从手央聲。
包# envelop + 手 hand/action indicator → envelop in the hands/arms → *embrace*; *hug*; *hold*; *have*; *carry*; *harbor* (ideas etc.) → *protect*; *brood*.
抲撝也。从手可聲。《周書》曰：“盡執，抲。”
捈也。从手世聲。
As per 氐# (press) + 手 hand/action indicator → *press*; *touch*; *reach* → *resist* (← press back in resistance).
擠也。从手氐聲。
笞擊也。从手失聲。
As per 末# (minute) + 手 hand/action indicator → *grind* an object to the point that it becomes minute → *rub*; *crush*; *erase*.
As per 申# (stretch) + 手 hand/action indicator → (pull and) *stretch*; *enlarge*.

As per 甲# (press down on) + 手 hand/action indicator → *press*/*push* down on → *thrust*; *shove*; *hold down*; *stop*; *stamp* (papers/a passport etc.); (a) *weight*; *pressure* → *seize*; *catch*; *arrest* → *control* (← restrain and control). 押 was devised to replace 甲 after the latter came to refer to a husk or shell.
As per 由# (pass/run through) + 手 hand/action indicator → *extract* an object by pulling it out → *pull out*; *pick (out)*.
As per 弗# (split) + 手 hand/action indicator → split/*sweep away* to both sides → *stroke*; *refuse* (compare 不 and 非). *Pay* is a borrowed meaning.
過擊也。从手弗聲。
As per 主# (stationary) + 手 hand/action indicator → set in place a *prop* or *support* that keeps another object stationary.

As per 旦# (long and flat) + 手 hand/action indicator → knock/beat down with a long and flat implement (compare 單). However, 担 was adopted as a Shinjitai (new character form) to replace 擔, according to which 担 bears the meanings *shoulder a load*; *load*; *bear* and *undertake*.
As per 斥# (split) + 手 hand/action indicator → *split*; *rip*; *open* → *destroy* (an argument).
母# mother + 手 hand (→ finger) → *thumb*; *big toe* (digits likened to a mother, the remaining fingers/toes likened to children).
將指也。从手母聲。
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 手 hand/action indicator → fix an object in place by picking it up or grasping it → *pick up/grasp* (with the fingertips). *Twist* and *twirl* are borrowed meanings.
𢬴也。从手占聲。
As per 立# (exert continuous downward pressure) + 手 hand/action indicator → *drag* a heavy person/object along the ground → *pull*; *draw*; *carry off*. Also, *crush* (← press down on and crush).
摧也。从手立聲。
付# attach + 手 hand/action indicator → attach the palm of one's hand to a person's cheek in slapping it → *slap*; *strike*. *Handle of a container* is a borrowed meaning.
揗也。从手付聲。
As per 半# (split) + 手 hand/action indicator → *break* an object into pieces → *mix*; *stir* (← break ingredients into smaller pieces and stir in a pot).
As per 白# (scatter) + 手 hand/action indicator → cause the hands to join then scatter in clapping → *clap* → *beat time*.
牽引也。从手奴聲。

叧# combines an abbreviated form of 冎 (joint of a bone) + 刀 sword/knife → sever/separate a limb from its joint. 拐 adds 手 hand/action indicator to reinforce the idea of physical separation, eventually acquiring the specific sense of separating a person from his/her kin → *kidnap*. Also,*deceive* (← use deception in kidnapping).
As per 甘# (contain) + 手 hand/action indicator → *contain*; *restrain*; *clamp*. Also, by a figurative application, *repress speech*.
脅持也。从手甘聲。
As per 巨# (distant) + 手 hand/action indicator → keep another person at a distance in defending oneself → *defend*; *refuse*; *deny*.
石# stone + 手 hand/action indicator → *clear/open up land* by removing stones.
拾也。陳、宋語。从手石聲。

As per 犮# (split away) + 手 hand/action indicator → split an object in plucking/pulling it upward → *pluck/pull out*. Extended meanings include *come off*, *fall out*, *select*, *surpass*, *remove* (an obstacle), *escape*, *omit*, *leave out*, *go/do without*, *be missing*, *error* and *see through to the very end*.
擢也。从手犮聲。
As per 它# (stretch) + 手 hand/action indicator → stretch in pulling, dragging or towing an object (compare 曳) → *pull*; *drag*; *tow*.
曳也。从手它聲。

As per 幼# (slight power) + 手 hand/action indicator → apply slight pressure in twisting an object → *twist* → *distorted*; *warped*; *break* (← twist to the point that an object becomes distorted/warped, or breaks). Also, *sulky* (← warped, perverse attitude).
手拉也。从手幼聲。
As per 句# (bend) + 手 hand/action indicator → *confine* a prisoner in a bending posture → *detain*; *adhere*.
止也。从句从手，句亦聲。
出# protrude + 手 hand/action indicator → arrange objects inexpertly, with some protruding → *inexpert*; *clumsy*.
不巧也。从手出聲。
As per 弁# (spread) + 手 hand → spread (the hands/wings) → *spread wings*; *spread* (in driving off/out). The compound 拚命 means to go all out, heedless of risk.
拊手也。从手弁聲。
召# summon + 手 hand/action indicator → summon/*beckon* (with the hand/arm) → *invite*; *engage* (professionally). Also, *bring about* and *incur* (← set in motion by beckoning).
手呼也。从手、召。

The relevant seal inscription form is 手 hand/action indicator + objects offered to the gods or a person of high rank (compare 奉) → *bow deeply* in making an offering, then split away (= make one's departure) → *respect*; *worship*; *pray to* → *receive* (an official post); *be assigned*.
As per 舌# (enclose) + 手 hand/action indicator → *enclose* by fastening, thereby including objects within → *fasten*, *include*. Also, *tie* and *bind* (← methods of fastening).
絜也。从手𠯑聲。
As per 式# (straight) + 手 hand/action indicator → *wipe* with a straight motion.
As per 吉# (reduce/eliminate space) + 手 hand/action indicator → *work hard*/*compete* (such in filling an object or compacting it). Compare 劼.
手口共有所作也。从手吉聲。《詩》曰：“予手拮据。”

丞# help + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *help*/*save* by raising a person out of danger → *aid*. 拯 was devised to emphasize/clarify the original sense of 丞 after 承 (composed of the same elements: 丞 + 手) came to be understood as raising a person to a post/rank rather than lifting him to safety.
As per 共# (act jointly) + 手 hand/action indicator → *fold the arms* (or cross the hands) on the chest → *observe but take no action*.
斂手也。从手共聲。
兩手同械也。从手从共，共亦聲。《周禮》：“上辠，梏拲而桎。”
As per 𠔉# as described in 券 (wrap/roll up) + 手 hand → hand balled into a *fist*.
手也。从手聲。
As per 存# (settle in place) + 手 hand/action indicator → *set/place* → *make*; *manufacture*; *craftsmanship*.

The right-hand element is 巛 as described in 甾 (cut off) + 夕 (here not "moon" but a variant of 歹 severed bone/death) → cut off the flow of blood. 拶 adds 手 hand/action indicator → press/squeeze a body part, cutting off the flow of blood → *come close* → *imminent*.
As per 考# (bend) + 手 hand/action indicator → *torture* by bending/twisting body parts → *strike*.
摺也。从手劦聲。一曰拉也。
曳# drag + 手 hand/action indicator (for emphasis/clarification) → *drag*; *pull*; *tow*.

As per 合# (press/fit together) + 手 hand/action indicator → *pick up*/*gather* scattered pieces and select that those fit together → *find* → *select*. Also, *catch* (a taxi) (← pick up) and *escape hardship* (← be picked/plucked out of hardship ← pick up). As with 壱, 弐, and 参/參, this character is used as a substitute for the usual number (in this case, 十) in documents as a precaution against forgery.
掇也。从手合聲。

As per 合 (press/fit together) + 手 hand/action indicator → *grab* a slave → *catch* → *arrest*. Originally, the character was written 拏, with 奴 in place of 合, suggesting the use of the hand in strenuous activity. Some dictionaries continue to give 拏 as standard, with 拿 noted as a variant form.
